summary: Opened a core-protocol investigation with a five-node in-process experiment: a new leader's decided index comes from the max decided among its prepare-quorum promises, and sync_log assigns that value unconditionally, so a follower that already decided entry 5 but promises after the quorum should have its decided index lowered by AcceptSync (read(4): Decided → Undecided) and then raised again when the new leader re-decides. Added seven anchors (sync_log, handle_acceptsync, handle_promise_accept, send_accsync, handle_majority_promises, handle_decide, log.md Decided guarantee), an unresolved source account, and the execution request. Prior runtime findings remain as recorded; this core claim awaits its receipt.
